exam_price_notes: Check the official booking page for the price in your country or region.
renewal_options: Microsoft certifications (Associate/Expert/Specialty) are renewed annually for free via a short renewal assessment on Microsoft Learn. Renewal assessment available 6 months before expiry. Fundamentals certifications do not expire.
target_audience: Candidates should have subject matter expertise in implementing, managing, and monitoring an organization’s Microsoft Azure environment, including virtual networks, storage, compute, identity, security, and governance
recommended_experience: Experience with PowerShell, Azure CLI, Azure portal, Azure Resource Manager templates or Bicep files, Microsoft Entra ID

prerequisites.description: PowerShell, Azure CLI, Azure portal, Azure Resource Manager templates or Bicep files, Microsoft Entra ID

retake_policy.notes: After the first failure, wait 24 hours. Wait 14 days between later attempts. At most five attempts in the 12 months starting with the first attempt; after five failures, wait until that period ends. Retake fees apply. See Microsoft's policy for exceptions.

study_actions.title: Atlas study exercise: Explain a storage access decision
study_actions.detail: For a file-sharing scenario, compare an identity-based permission with a shared access signature. Record the scope, lifetime and revocation approach, then locate the corresponding storage objective. Separately explain where containers and virtual machine scale sets belong in the compute outline. This is a study aid, not an official exam question or a prediction of your result.
